says: Very few comments were captured for this theme; the only reading is on a first-session tattoo removal clip, where viewers say it triggers trypophobia and is agony to watch. The run-1 questions fill in the rest and they are all about the week after: “does it hurt?” (254 likes), “How long is recovery?”, “How soon can you wear foundation after each session?”, “How many sessions” and “What if your skin scars super easily”. The claims point at the same worries: pain, downtime, burns on darker skin, and paying thousands for nothing.
